title: Stop sounding like a robot, use this instead
description:
Every AI writing tool leaves the same fingerprints, and readers spot them instantly. This is how to make Claude write like a human using one instruction file built from the Wikipedia list of AI writing signs plus the research on why models write that way.

Works for emails, funnels, landing pages and ad copy. No detector, no rewriting by hand.

Get the full human writing document here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DuNdsNAkfb5gYXAj6nS1La9ISBFWvQ_3-cDScos1ZyQ/edit?usp=sharing
